paragraphs: So it appears in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:4, reporting in Rav's name. But the plain meaning is: Rabbi Ba in the name of Rabbi Chuna; Rabbi Yirmiyah (bar Abba) traces it back to Rav.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot paragraph has matu bah, an attribution formula leading back to Rav. Hyman’s “of Tuva” is the reading under discussion, not a newly established place of origin.

The consulted Jerusalem Berakhot passage transmits through Ba, Chuna and Yirmeyah matubah to Rav. The reading “of Tuva” and Hyman’s parenthetical identification remain source interpretations; this comparison does not establish a place of origin or identify the transmitter with another person.
